The test image shows a stem cross-section placed in a clear beaker of water. Key observations:
- Brown/dark streaking on the stem exterior (vascular discoloration)
- Milky/cloudy bacterial streaming visible flowing down from the cut stem into the water
- This is the classic **bacterial streaming test** used to diagnose bacterial wilt

This diagnostic technique — placing a stem in water and observing milky ooze streaming — is the definitive test for *Ralstonia solanacearum* (bacterial wilt). Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference image (5606063) and test image (5606064) are from the same photo series — consecutive Bugwood images showing the identical bacterial streaming test for tomato stem. Both show:
- Stem cross-section with brown vascular discoloration
- Milky bacterial ooze streaming downward through the water
- Same beaker/lab setup

This is an exact match to **Bacterial_Wilt**.
